scope: physical interpretation of source borders; source reference adjacency is preserved

rules.retain: requires repeatable boundary stability in at least two independent physical fields plus exchange or retention behavior distinguishable from matched controls and adequate seasonal/interannual support
rules.merge: requires weak cross-border contrast in at least two independent observed properties plus exchange consistent with an interior control and no persistent boundary across seasons and years
rules.split: requires at least one reproducible internal boundary supported by two independent fields, controls, and multiseason or multiyear persistence
rules.move: requires a displaced boundary with repeatable location/envelope in at least two independent fields and more than one year, plus improvement over the source edge under frozen controls
rules.demote: requires a tested physical-boundary candidate to fail at least two independent declared tests, including a matched-control or stability test; demotion affects the physical overlay only
rules.unknown: required whenever no other disposition meets its full rule

conflict_policy: Do not collapse conflicting evidence into one scalar score. Preserve every evidence family and choose unknown when a rule is incomplete.
reference_policy: No automated disposition deletes, merges, splits, or moves the Longhurst Version 4 source geometry. Candidate physical overlays are shown beside the source edition.
approval_policy: Repository role approval validates implementation and claim discipline only. Owner approval and external scientific review are separate prerequisites for any adopted zoning revision.
boundary: This policy can disposition only evidence admitted in the current bounded program. Unknown is an intended result, and a segment-level demotion cannot be generalized to an untested global edge.
